title: CVE-2024-21762: Fortinet FortiOS Out-of-Bound Write Vulnerability
reasons: FortiOS 7.2.6 is inside the affected range 7.2.0 to below 7.2.7
Listed in CISA KEV: exploited in the wild
Internet-facing perimeter firewall on a criticality 5 asset
limitations: Inventory version is simulated, not read from a live device
recommended_actions: Upgrade FortiOS on PWR-FW-01 to 7.2.7 or later
Until patched, disable SSL-VPN on this firewall
Review VPN logs for T1190 exploit activity
